description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). XI (ID primary key, indexes on N and on G) and XD1 (no primary key, only an index on N DESC). Dynasets of SELECT ID, s FROM XI WHERE: N <= 6; N > 3; N < 6; N <> 5; N >= 3 AND N <= 6; N >= 3 AND G >= 0; N >= 3 AND ID + 0 > 0; N Is Not Null; NOT (N < 3); and SELECT ID, s FROM XD1 WHERE N <= 6; N > 3. Asks which restriction forms take the index, and whether a descending index serves a range in either direction. Rows (ID, N, G) inserted (5, 3, 1), (2, 7, 2), (8, 1, 1), (1, 6, 2), (7, 4, 1), (3, 8, 2), (6, 2, 1), (4, 5, 2), s 'r1' to 'r8' in insertion order; indexes made before the rows.
